title: Heated Water Bowl for Winter Birds – 2.2 Liters
seo_description: Heated water bowl for winter birds at the bird table. Keeps the water open in the cold, 2.2 liters, green/black, EU plug (220–230 V), cord with metal spring.
descriptionHtml:
The water freezes to ice before the birds have had a drink

On a winter morning you put out fresh water at the bird table – an hour later the bowl is a sheet of ice. You chip the ice loose, carry out new water, maybe several times a day, and when the cold bites hardest, the great tits, blue tits and bullfinches still have nothing to drink.

A bowl that keeps the water open for you

The bowl is heated so the water doesn't freeze, and plugs in with a standard EU plug (220–230 V). It holds 2.2 liters, is green/black, and the cord is protected by a metal spring all the way along.

Features

  • The water stays open instead of freezing to ice – the bowl is heated and connects with an EU plug (220–230 V).
  • No more chipping out ice and carrying out fresh water several times a day – the water stays open on its own.
  • Suits places where there's already power nearby – EU plug, 220–230 V, in a standard wall outlet by the bird table, patio or porch.
  • The cord is protected against gnawing – a metal spring runs along its entire length.
  • Holds 2.2 liters, so you refill less often – the bowl holds 2.2 liters of water.
